_comment: Schelet generic de auto-update, consumat local. Sursa reala de update pentru aplicatie e docs/media-flow-monitor/update.json (gordas.dev), citit de UpdateChecker.swift.
releaseNotes: v1.2.0: Dashboard Pro complet — grafice live VRAM/Swap si CPU per-thread, Real-time Log Decoder colorat, panou de Diagnostic si Recomandari, detectare automata + selectie manuala a folderului CacheClip (inclusiv discuri externe Thunderbolt), bara de actiuni Purge Cache / Force Sync Log / Optimise System.
